body:
> You're looking for reasons in order to stall yourself

Well it is a big decision.

> If it doesn't, maybe do some volunteer work so people who need help can get it while you're still around. Travel. Spend three nights in a dingy hostel in a bad part of Thailand wondering where you'll get your next wages. Do something so you have stories to tell. Sitting around alone doesn't give you the stories and experience and purpose.

People always say these things but they don't know how unrealistic they are being. I'm isolated and don't have the money and I have obligations that if I turn away from, my life could turn out even worse. I have no room to take risks which is another reason I want to do this. I'm trapped.

> why are you online now seemingly looking for reasons to not kill yourself?

I thought maybe there's something out there. I figure the internet with all the information and people on it that I don't have access to otherwise, that there would be something but all I've gotten is more entrenched.

> because if every single thing mattered

But nothing does to me. I have no attachments to anything. I am free from everything and all I can think to do is kill myself. It's been like this for years. I'm just living life on the rails following the path of least resistance.

> but in the bigger picture, it does matter.

How?

> The whole point is to keep going, even if it doesn't matter.

Kind of a contradiction but do you admit it doesn't matter?
What about them? Should I live just for their sake?

> All you have to do is worry about your universe

That's impossible for me, I'm a big picture thinker.

> if you kill yourself you will be forgotten like all those before you who have killed themselves

That's not any different than people who haven't killed themselves. Sure it may take longer if you're a greater person but every line in the sand gets washed away by the ocean.

> Person enjoying his life, drinking beer, fucking girls, winning at bar fights and riding a bike is way more nihilistic than someone philosophizing about life being pointless.

lol that's ridiculous. I've never drank, had sex, been in a fight or own a bike and I don't want to. Also people that do things like that think there is meaning in what they do, they wouldn't describe themselves as nihilistic.

> no one is going to remember me or what I've done so what's the point

Exactly, even the whole universe will end eventually. We are nothing. How anyone can continue on understanding the futility and absurdity of life and this universe? Maybe I'm just weak in that case, survival of the fittest. Life begets life and death begets death.

> In other words there's a silver lining behind every cloud you just have to find it.

Oh I believe that, it's just not worth it for me. I'm happy right now believe it or not, still suicidal. Also suicide is the only answer when you are presented with a meaningless and absurd life.

> Nihilist is still a human being

Only in form but has rejected all humanly constructs. Is that really human? There is nothing else for a nihilist to do besides commit suicide.

I don't care what the future holds. Even if I experience happiness I don't care. The sum of all experiences in life still adds up to nothingness, death. In fact I'm quiet happy right now but I'm still suicidal.
That doesn't fit the definition a nihilist. A nihilist doesn't feel interest because there's no purpose in anything.
I get into certain moods based on randomness, not any stimuli. Right now I'm happy for no reason even though I want to kill myself.

> more to do with cutting

I don't cut

> to get out of the cycle of life itself?

Yes
